privileged_info_for_vlm: The scenario directory must be exactly '/opt/bridgecommand/Scenarios/Exp) Vigilance Study 4H/'. The critical calculation for the intercept is: Own ship speed (12) + Target speed (18) = 30 knots relative speed. Over 4 hours, they cover 120 nautical miles. At 60nm per degree of latitude, this is a 2.0-degree separation. Since Own Ship starts at 49.0N heading North (000) and Target is heading South (180) to meet it, the Target must start at 49.0 + 2.0 = 51.0N. The target longitude must be -2.50 to match the ownship for a head-on encounter.
